hints.title: Key Value Pair Bucket Chaining
hints.text: Store key-value pairs in buckets indexed by modular projection, updating values upon duplicate keys.

hints.title: Collision Bucket Scanning and Replacement
hints.text: Hash key to bucket index. When putting, if key matches an existing pair in the bucket, update its value; otherwise append pair. On remove, delete the pair.

hints.title: MyHashMap Blueprint
hints.text: In init: buckets = [[] for _ in range(769)]. put(key, val): h = key % 769; find pair and update or append. get(key): scan bucket h, return val or -1. remove(key): scan bucket h, delete pair if present.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of unique keys inserted
complexity.notes: Modulo hash distribution ensures constant average time per insertion, retrieval, and deletion.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full flat array initialization of size 10^6 wastes memory when sparse keys are used.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prime bucket array minimizes clustering while maintaining small memory footprint.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling collision resolution and updating existing keys without duplicate entries.
